# PeakAndPack Test Cases (API Agent)

**Phase:** 3, Approach D, AI Agent
**Based on:** `peakandpack-requirements.md` (Phase 1), generated by `api-testcase-agent.js`, reviewed by RN
**Author:** Claude (Anthropic), via the API test case generator prompt, reviewed by RN

---

## How this differs from the UI agent set

Same run pattern as `test-cases-ui-agent.md`, same source document, different prompt: this one is scoped to endpoints and data operations only, status codes and response bodies, never what a screen shows. Where the UI agent asks "what does the user see," this one asks "what does the server return." Run non-interactively, then reviewed the same way as every other approach in this series.

## What the review pass changed

| Change | Why |
|---|---|
| Confirmed TC-A05's expected result (`SAVE10` reduces total by exactly 10 percent) is a hard requirement, not a suggestion | Matches the acceptance criteria verbatim: "the total becomes $90, not $0." The live app currently fails this (BUG-009); the test case is correct, the app is wrong. |
| Added TC-A12, the stock-check-before-order case | The requirements are explicit that checkout must check stock before confirming. Draft had a generic "invalid item" case that didn't capture this specific rule. Rewritten by hand. |
| Added TC-A14, cross-user order access | The draft tested `GET /api/orders` generically but never tested requesting another user's order by ID, the actual authorization risk called out in the requirements (see BUG-010). |
| Removed three duplicate malformed-payload cases | The draft produced near-identical "missing field" cases across Cart, Checkout, and Auth; kept one representative per endpoint. |

## Test cases (after review)

### Products

| TC-ID | Title | Steps | Expected | Priority |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| TC-A01 | List products | GET /api/products | 200, array of products, each with a non-negative price | High |
| TC-A02 | Search by query | GET /api/products?q=tent | 200, only products matching "tent" in name or description | Medium |
| TC-A03 | Search with blank query | GET /api/products?q= | ASSUMPTION: requirements don't specify blank-query behaviour exactly; expect either 400 or the full list, never a 500 | Medium |

### Cart

| TC-ID | Title | Steps | Expected | Priority |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| TC-A04 | Add item, logged in | POST /api/cart with a valid product id and quantity, authenticated | 200, item added, total reflects the product's database price, not a client-supplied one | High |
| TC-A06 | Cart access without auth | GET /api/cart with no session | 401, no cart data returned | Critical |
| TC-A07 | Add item with negative quantity | POST /api/cart with quantity -1 | 400, cart unchanged | High |
| TC-A08 | Cart total matches line items | GET /api/cart after adding two different products | Total equals the sum of (price × quantity) for each line | Critical |

### Checkout

| TC-ID | Title | Steps | Expected | Priority |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| TC-A05 | Checkout with valid discount code | POST /api/checkout with cart total $100, code SAVE10 | 200/201, total is $90, not $0 | Critical |
| TC-A09 | Checkout with empty cart | POST /api/checkout with no items in cart | 400, no order created | High |
| TC-A10 | Checkout with invalid discount code | POST /api/checkout with code FAKE99 | Code ignored, full price charged | Medium |
| TC-A12 | Checkout with out-of-stock item | POST /api/checkout with a product at stock 0 | Order rejected before confirmation, not silently accepted | High |
| TC-A11 | Price tampering | POST /api/checkout with a client-supplied price that differs from the database price | Server uses its own price, ignores the client value | Critical |

### Auth

| TC-ID | Title | Steps | Expected | Priority |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| TC-A13 | Register with duplicate email | POST /api/register with an email already in use | 409, no second account created | High |
| TC-A15 | Register with empty name | POST /api/register with name: "" | ASSUMPTION: requirements don't explicitly cover this field; expected is 400, but this is a known gap (see BUG-006) | Medium |
| TC-A16 | Login with wrong password | POST /api/login with a correct email, incorrect password | 401, no session token issued | Critical |
| TC-A17 | Expired token on protected route | GET /api/orders with a token older than 24 hours | 401, forces re-authentication | High |

### Orders

| TC-ID | Title | Steps | Expected | Priority |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| TC-A18 | View own orders | GET /api/orders, authenticated as user A | 200, only user A's orders | Critical |
| TC-A14 | Cross-user order access | GET /api/orders/{id}, authenticated as user A, requesting an order that belongs to user B | 403 or 404, never user B's order data (see BUG-010) | Critical |

---

## Review note

This is agent-generated, then reviewed, not agent-authored and shipped as-is. The clearest gap the agent produced on its own: TC-A05 and TC-A12 both encode rules the requirements state explicitly (the exact discount percentage, and stock must be checked before order confirmation), and the agent got both of them right on the first pass, because the acceptance criteria section spells them out in plain language. The cases it needed correction on, TC-A14 and TC-A15, are the ones where the risk is implied by a general principle ("users must only see their own data," "registration must require a non-empty email and password") rather than written as a literal rule, exactly the pattern the manual and manual+AI approaches ran into as well.
